raw_findings.description: FastAPI CORSMiddleware allow_origins=['*'] permits any origin (CWE-942).
raw_findings.remediation: List explicit trusted origins; avoid '*' especially with credentials.

raw_findings.description: allow_credentials=True combined with a wildcard origin exposes credentialed cross-origin reads (CWE-942).
raw_findings.remediation: Do not combine allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*'; use an explicit origin list.
